message: Done. Hypothesis 'flat = floods': partly, confounded by lowness. Flattest decile 2.5x the expected IMEPLAN sites (flatness AUC 0.66 at ~175 m, 0.49 at 5 m), but within HAND strata flatness AUC 0.49-0.57 and the spatial-CV AUC is 0.808 with flatness vs 0.807 without. HAND (>=1 km2 streams) AUC 0.79. Final model (HAND, DTM depressions, TWI, TPI 500 m/2 km): spatial-CV AUC 0.807; independent Zapopan calls 0.64. Viewer /labs/sim-relieve/ (?demo=1, window.__cauceDemo). Data in /labs/shared/hazard/modeled/sim-relieve/ (tiles, routing polygons opt-in, stats.json, README.md, ageb-terrain.json keyed by cvegeo). W10 folder 4.7 GB.
